name: Arakure Hime
source:
Level: 17

Her appearance is completely muscular, but she appears to be a princess of the capital of warriors.

She's not afraid to take a hit with her heavy hammer, which can crush any demon. But even such a rough princess is no match for a hero. After being twisted by force and made into a hand basket, her masochistic feminine side blossoms.

[Translated from [url=http://www.caramel-box.com/products/geko-brave/character.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
